tools.name: motobase_compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2–6 products side by side: identity rows plus every spec property with its own source.

items.description: Product identifier from a previous tool result: its `slug` (preferred), its `publicId`, or a deprecated numeric id. Never guess it.

tools.name: motobase_find_replacement
tools.description: Find replacement candidates for a motor model: resolves the typed model (status resolved / resolved_edition / series_only / ambiguous / not_found), then lists manufacturer-stated replacements and same-series / same-brand candidates with matched values, differences, unchecked items and missing-data reasons. Optional torque / rpm / diameter / voltage from the motor label complete or stand in for the target (reported under data.override and target.assumption). When nothing resolves (not_found / ambiguous) data.resolution.suggestions lists up to 10 search hits to offer as "did you mean" (suggestionsText); they are not matches. Spec comparisons only — never a fit or compatibility statement; relay the disclaimer.

model.description: Motor model as printed on its label, brand optional (e.g. "becker r8 17 c01", "oximo rts 10/17", "AM35-6/28").

brand.description: Brand slug to restrict the lookup (e.g. "becker").

tiers.description: a = manufacturer-stated replacement, b = same series, c = same brand (default all three).

torque.description: Rated torque (Nm) from the label. Completes a model we lack data for, overrides a value read from the model name, or (with brand, rpm and diameter) stands in for an unknown model.

rpm.description: Rated speed (rpm) from the label; same rules as torque.

diameter.description: Motor diameter class in mm: one of 22, 25, 28, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 58, 60.

tools.name: motobase_get_product
tools.description: Get one product: claim-sourced specs (value, unit, source URL, observed date) and publicly verifiable certifications.

slug.description: Product identifier from a previous tool result: its `slug` (preferred), its `publicId`, or a deprecated numeric id. Never guess it.

tools.name: motobase_get_series
tools.description: Get one product series: members with lifecycle, variant-axis values (each spec value with its claim id), the axis × axis matrix and verified replacement / successor relations.

brand.description: Slug from a series page URL (/products/series/<brand>/<series>) or a previous result. Never guess it.

series.description: Slug from a series page URL (/products/series/<brand>/<series>) or a previous result. Never guess it.

tools.name: motobase_get_spec_template
tools.description: Get the parameter template of a spec category (tubular, curtain, venetian, window_opener, controller, accessory): groups, rows, which rows are required for completeness, compare rules and tolerances.

tools.name: motobase_list_certifications
tools.description: List publicly verifiable certifications (Matter/CSA, FCC, ...) filtered by product, manufacturer or standard.

product.description: Product identifier from a previous tool result: its `slug` (preferred), its `publicId`, or a deprecated numeric id. Never guess it.

company.description: Company identifier from a previous tool result: its `slug` (preferred) or a deprecated numeric id. Never guess it.

tools.name: motobase_list_events
tools.description: Industry events calendar (motors, shading, doors & gates, smart home): reviewed trade-show / conference / standards-meeting editions with dates, city, country, organisers and official links. `note` carries editorial caveats (e.g. unverified dates) — relay them. Never a ticketing or exhibitor-list source.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the venue, e.g. DE, CN.

month.description: Editions running in this month, YYYY-MM.

tools.name: motobase_recent_signals
tools.description: Most recent human-reviewed industry news and compliance updates.

tools.name: motobase_search_products
tools.description: Search and filter published motor / smart-motion products (24 per page) by text, category, manufacturer, control protocol, power supply type or certification status. Returns summaries with slugs for motobase_get_product.

q.description: Full-text query: model, series, brand or keyword.

category.description: Category key, e.g. tubular_motor, curtain_motor, blind_motor.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer: company `slug` (or a deprecated numeric id).

control_protocol.description: Control protocol value(s). Matches products having at least one of them. Same values as /api/v1/products’ `control_protocol` param.

power_supply.description: Power supply type(s). Matches products having at least one of them. Same values as /api/v1/products’ `power_supply` param.

certified.description: Only products with at least one active, publicly verifiable certification.

min_spec_completeness.description: Only products whose stored spec completeness (0–1, required template rows filled) is at least this value.
